title: Tunable Hybridization of Whispering Gallery Modes in High-Index Photonic Molecules
byline: Panda; Ayusmin; Nanda; Birabar Ranjit Kumar
html:
Abstract:Photonic molecules formed by coupled dielectric microresonators provide a platform for controlling collective optical modes, yet the interplay between molecular topology, resonator detuning, and dielectric environment in determining their spectral response remains insufficiently quantified. Here, we systematically quantify the evolution of Whispering Gallery Mode (WGM) hybridization in high-index TiO$_2$ and perovskite coated TiO$_2$ microresonators with molecular topology, and establish the corresponding effective inter-cavity coupling using a combined numerical and analytical analysis. We further show that perovskite-shell incorporation provides a diameter and thickness-dependent modification of the effective coupling, producing a non-monotonic response rather than a uniform suppression of coupling. Despite the resulting closely spaced hybridized resonances in the high-index perovskite environment, the supermodes remain spectrally resolvable, with $Q$-factor of order \(10^3\) for representative modes. The observed spectral splitting is quantitatively related to the effective inter-cavity coupling strengths, revealing a non-monotonic coupling response to perovskite-shell incorporation that depends on resonator size and shell thickness. These results establish molecular topology and dielectric environment as distinct parameters for controlling WGM hybridization, inter-cavity coupling, and spectral response, providing a basis for the design of coupled resonator systems for applications in optical sensing, filtering, switching, and other resonant photonic devices.
